threads.summary: Welltower is signing a new UK contract and wants the same options as the US one. Add a required Region dropdown (North America / UK) at the top of the Jotform that routes the job to the right Airtable client, filters property locations, and switches the size field between sq ft and sq m.
threads.note: Snehal asked Kailyn (11/2) whether the UK property list should be grouped by State or by operator; Kailyn owes the answer.
